subject.title: Sidebar session groups cannot be renamed, deleted, kept empty, or turned off

question: Should the requested sidebar group-header management and flat-list toggle land now through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101117, or should the web-only scope be narrowed or deferred?
rationale: The request adds new user-facing Control UI management surface and a persisted browser preference on a fresh session-grouping feature, and the protected maintainer label means automation should not decide that product scope alone.

options.title: Review the linked web PR
options.body: Keep this issue open and use the linked PR as the candidate implementation for sidebar group management and flat-list mode.

options.title: Narrow or defer scope
options.body: Keep the issue open but ask the PR to split web-only group management from cross-client parity or other follow-up behavior.

options.title: Decline the controls
options.body: If maintainers do not want this sidebar management surface, close both the issue and linked PR with the accepted alternative workflow.

recommendation.title: Review the linked web PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and use the linked PR as the candidate implementation for sidebar group management and flat-list mode.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the original session grouping feature and the linked implementation candidate, so they have the strongest current context for the product-scope choice.
